name: Crimson Classic
where: Tuscaloosa, AL · host Alabama · Harry Pritchett Running Park
headline: Crimson Classic
summary: Final: Men: No. 4 Alabama swept the top five for a perfect-score 15, well ahead of Georgia Tech (70) and Auburn (100), and Dismus Lokira won the 8K in 23:05.3. Women: No. 10 Alabama beat No. 11 South Carolina 17-42, with Mississippi State third (132) and Caren Kiplagat winning in 18:31.7.
